description: Prototype behavioral architecture APPROVED. Three PRIMARY behavioral plays locked in sequence PRESENT → OBSERVE → DECIDE. Smallest sufficient primary architecture; no additional primary Plays unless prototype development reveals a substantive behavioral gap.

Resolves the previously-held CP-06/C1. Governing logic = Discernment requires accurate information about both people; excessive self-editing degrades that information (NOT 'be vulnerable to be chosen').
OBSERVATION component. Consolidates STM-0395 + STM-0042 + the translated observation component of STM-1039 (observe consistency in Exploration, not Exclusivity promises).
DECISION component; condition-based, no arbitrary calendar timelines. Distinct from T2: T2 gathers/interprets evidence, T3 uses sufficient evidence to decide continue/deepen/slow/discontinue.
HELD / NOT ADMITTED to Cluster 1. Precedent: developmental-task relevance ALONE is insufficient for cross-cluster admission; center of gravity is partner selection, not Difficulty Feeling Chosen.

target: Primary Behavioral Play vs Context-Activated Play
description: Introduced. A Context-Activated Play becomes relevant only when its triggering circumstance is present. Intentional Dating Break = Context-Activated (dating fatigue/burnout), NOT part of the primary sequence and not a universal C1 response. Recorded for potential reuse across other Experience Clusters.

Status = 'Provisionally Validated — Cluster 1 Prototype'. Cluster 1 demonstrated the rule can: close a genuine behavioral evidence gap; preserve canonical mappings; reject weak semantic associations; prevent unsupported prevalence claims; prevent unsupported psychological mechanisms; and produce a smaller, coherent behavioral architecture. GLOBAL validation still requires successful application to additional clusters with different phenomenological/developmental profiles.
